_comment: apps/web/src/sheets/** matched no rule at all and fell through to the default, so a change to how a sheet is composed or exported selected neither browser_sheet_export nor the import/export lane. The gap was reachable: moving the exporter behind a dynamic import - which is what put a run-time failure mode where a build-time one had been - touched only App.tsx and this directory. The directory now sits with packages/pdf-export/** in the import-export rule that already owns the PDF writer.
